title: Finite etale descent of the existence of a lisse integral structure
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite with valuation ring $A=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme], on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] write $A_X(V)=C(|V|,A)$ and $E_X(V)=C(|V|,E)$, with pointwise ring operations and restriction by precomposition. Here pro-etale locally free of finite rank means that there is a covering of the final object in the pro-etale site on each member of which the module is isomorphic to a finite direct sum of copies of its coefficient ring sheaf; ranks may vary between members, and rank zero is allowed. Inverse images are those of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Modules and tensor products are sheaf modules and sheaf tensor products [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Assume that the underlying topological space of $X$ is noetherian (every ascending chain of opens stabilizes). Let $p:Y\to X$ be finite etale and surjective [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category, def-weil-surjective-morphism]. Let $L$ be an $E_X$-module sheaf pro-etale locally free of finite rank. If there is an $A_Y$-module sheaf $M$ pro-etale locally free of finite rank with $E_Y\otimes_{A_Y}M\cong p^{-1}L$, then there exists an $A_X$-module sheaf $M_0$ pro-etale locally free of finite rank with $E_X\otimes_{A_X}M_0\cong L$. No descent datum on $M$ is required, and no assertion that $p^{-1}M_0$ equals the specified $M$ is made.

proof.text: Construct N as the actual image-pullback of the pushed integral embedding along the restricted rational adjunction unit. This uses no local descent choices and no integral/section-module conversion.
The qcqs rationalization theorem proves that the canonical Ext(N)→P is invertible. Finite p is qcqs; the theorem does not use local freeness.

Use the integral local matrix model of N. Its matrices have epi rationalization, so the proved matrix-pivot induction gives locally finite free kernels. Undo coefficient normalization and compose the covers. Package the explicitly constructed N with this covering and its canonical rationalization isomorphism.

Rationalization, continuous finite-matrix denominators, the integral kernel conversion and local-freeness pivot induction are proved. The only new hole is continuousLatticeIntersection_splitData: finite-sheet coordinates for the three objects and two canonical maps on compact covering members. The image-pullback split model is proved from these coordinates. This is a decomposition, net zero direct holes, not a completed axiom-free proof. theorem continuousLisse_finiteEtale_lattice
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : Type) [NormedField E]
    [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[ℓ] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[ℓ] E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X]
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
    (hP : ∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
      Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).obj
        (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
        (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).mapMod _).obj P))
    {U : Scheme.{u}} (p : U ⟶ X) [IsFinite p] [Etale p] [Surjective p]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) U))
    (hM : ∃ D : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage U, ∀ s : D.I₀,
        Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (D.f s)).obj
          (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) U))
          (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (D.f s)).mapMod _).obj M))
    (e : Nonempty ((Mod.extendScalars
      (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) U)).obj M ≅
        (CondensedRing.upperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) p).obj P)) :
    ∃ N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
        (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X),
      (∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
        Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).obj
          (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X))
          (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).mapMod _).obj N)) ∧
      Nonempty ((Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X)).obj N ≅ P)
